title: nadayantra
text: A FastHTML app. You teach it a few sounds, bind each one to a glyph or key, and it types for you. Sounds are recognised in-process by nada (wav2vec 2.0 on Modular MAX), with an Observable Framework frontend in frontend/.

title: nadayantra
text:
Install
pixi install
nada is expected next to this repo (../nada), with its checkpoint in ../nada/models. Set NADA_MODELS to use a different directory.

title: nadayantra
text:
Run
pixi run serve
The app listens on http://localhost:5001.

title: nadayantra
text:
Develop
This is an nbdev project. Library code lives in notebooks under nbs/ and is exported to the nadayantra package: core, engine (the nada model), keys (macOS keyboard access), api (JSON for the frontend) and main (the FastHTML app). Edit the notebooks, never the exported .py files:
pixi run nbdev-export
pixi run nbdev-test

title: engine
api
text:
main keeps every page and route it already had. This module only adds, beside them:

/api/...: the same operations as JSON, built from main’s own functions
/app/: the built frontend (frontend/dist), when it exists

and lets the frontend’s dev server (http://localhost:3000) call the API from another origin.

title: main
text: Run it with pixi run serve (the nadayantra command). The app listens on http://127.0.0.1:5001; the JSON API for the Observable frontend is mounted from nadayantra.api.
